assets.title: Camp Runner
assets.identity: Adult man about24, lean angular face, cropped dark-brown hair, clean-shaven, warm olive skin and brown eyes. Clear right-facing THREE-QUARTER face, eyes focused beyond the right of the viewer.
assets.action: A dusty Macedonian military camp with canvas tents, distant pikes, low mountains and dawn smoke. The runner has just stopped at a tent rope, one hand cradling a small rolled dispatch bound with a plain red cord, the other hand holding the strap of a small leather message satchel.
